fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and civic affairs coverage involving Miami and Miami Beach officials, including discussion of Mayor Everest George Sewell and city commission matters. Contains reporting and opinion on racing and pari-mutuel issues and seasonal tourism, along with extensive horse-racing tips and track-related advertising. Also includes radio program schedules, local business and nightlife items, and brief reports on topics such as apartment rentals, funeral home/casket supply disputes, and organization of retail beverage dealers in Dade County.
